annotation.title_clean: Worker participation and representation: the impact on risk prevention of AI worker management systems
annotation.title_en: Worker participation and representation: the impact on risk prevention of AI worker management systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA publication page for a 32-page report (Nov 2024) on AI-based worker management systems, psychosocial risks, and how worker representation can prevent them. It notes obstacles from opaque systems and employer-employee power imbalances, and calls for further research. Not about physical robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI worker management systems create psychosocial risks for workers
Workers' representatives can help prevent and mitigate unwanted outcomes
Representation faces obstacles from the opaque nature of AIWM and power imbalances
Further research is needed to find solutions
